label: Levels from fanins
subgoals: Put vertices with no fanin at level 0
Set each other level to one more than its deepest fanin
Compute the levels in one pass over a topological order

label: Depth and width
subgoals: Count the levels to get logic depth plus one
Count the vertices at a level to get its width
Use narrow levels to locate serial bottlenecks

label: Levels in incremental analysis
subgoals: Key dirty vertices by level in a priority structure
Pop the lowest level first so fanins are always done
Keep levels topologically consistent after edits
